why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft, page layout, solid page above the settings, Shift tooltip, keys, buff audit

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- The small page of the floating icon: the line 'nothing recorded yet' was under the title. The page is a bit taller, and has a solid back, so when it is over the settings window the settings no longer show through. It opens above the settings window too (and so do the intro and the right click menu).
- Holding Shift over the icon or the minimap button emptied the tooltip (the game rebuilds a tooltip with the function that made it, ours has none). It is built again one frame after the key.
- The character could not walk while our settings were open. Every key except Esc now goes on to the game on each key press, and after Ctrl+C in a report box the keyboard goes back to the game at once (a box that keeps the focus keeps every key).

New (to find what is missing)
- Every line of a buff tooltip that is still plain English after the pass goes in the report as kind aura, with the names of the frames the tooltip came from. So a buff like Aspect of the Hawk shows up in the report, and we see which path it came through.
- In a fight, when the game hands a tooltip over unreadable (a secret text), the report says so (combatskip :: tooltip-secret or aura-secret).

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- Update and New tags, the buffs switch on the Game windows page with a preview, the experimental combat option on the Quests page, the report icon, the game windows switch OFF by default.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
